name: Dan Thomas
prior_offices: Crook County assessor (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Dan Thomas is the Crook County assessor and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official elected officials page lists him in that office, and the official general election summary lists him as the winner of the assessor race.

sources.name: Crook County official 2026 general election summary
